load_mnist_noise_env: load an MNIST bandit environment with configurable reward noise scale and random seed
run_mnist_noise_experiment: run the MNIST noise experiment by calling load with a noise scale and seed
review_load_function: review the load function that wraps MNISTBandit with RewardNoise and sets episode count
summarize_mnist_noise: summarize the MNIST noise experiment which tests generalization under noisy rewards
test_mnist_noise_load: test the load function by creating an environment with different noise scales and seeds
